settings.title: Details
settings.content:
Sophisticated yet functional, the Meridian Tote carries your whole day — laptop, planner, and all — in a softly structured shape that never looks like it’s working that hard.

Short top handles for the hand or the forearm, and a removable adjustable crossbody strap in the box for the days you need both hands.

settings.title: Delivery
settings.content:
Free shipping on all orders over $75. Once your order is placed, it ships and arrives within 7 to 10 business days.

We accept returns within 30 days of delivery for items in original, unused condition with all tags attached. Exchanges are always free. If something isn’t right, reach out — we’ll make it right.

settings.title: Care
settings.content:
Material
Premium grained leather with polished metal accents and reinforced handles.

Care
Wipe clean with a soft, dry cloth and condition every 6–12 months with a neutral leather cream. Avoid prolonged exposure to water, heat, and direct sunlight.

settings.title: Dimensions & Fit
settings.content:
Width: 14.6"  |  Height: 9.4"  |  Depth: 5.9"
37 × 24 × 15 cm

Carry: short top handles for the hand or the forearm, plus a removable adjustable crossbody strap in the box.

What it fits: a 15-inch laptop, a notebook or planner, a full wallet, a water bottle and a makeup bag. The side panels expand when you need the extra room, and one full-length zip pocket runs down the centre of the interior.

settings.headline: Built Around a 15-Inch Laptop
settings.body: Every line traces back to the silhouette inside. Suede sleeve. Rigid back panel. Magnetic top.

settings.headline: Drum-Dyed Full-Grain
settings.body: Color that lives in the leather, not on top of it. Edges painted in eight coats, hand-sanded between each.

settings.headline: Florentine Brass Hardware
settings.body: Solid brass feet, recessed pulls, antiqued by hand. Won’t tarnish. Won’t snag.

settings.headline: Suede-lined throughout
settings.body: Tonal microsuede — kinder to a laptop, holds the structure crisp.

settings.headline: Three pockets, sized for a life
settings.body: One zip for the wallet, two open for the phone and passport. Magnetic top stays shut.

settings.headline: Four solid brass feet
settings.body: Keep the bag off the ground, off the train floor, off the bar.

settings.headline: 15-inch sleeve, padded
settings.body: Drops in flat against the rigid back panel. No friction.
